args.question: What colour is the LED on the base station right now, and is the base station connected to the new router via an Ethernet cable (and if so, which port is it plugged into)?

args.action: Ask the customer to check the Ethernet cable running from the base station to the new router. It must be plugged into one of the router's LAN ports (usually numbered 1-4, often yellow), NOT the WAN/Internet port (often blue or labelled "Internet"). Have them unplug and reseat the cable firmly into a LAN port, then check the base station LED — it should turn from solid red to solid green/blue within a minute or two.

Ask the customer to power-cycle both devices: (1) unplug the base station's power adapter, (2) unplug the new router's power, (3) wait 30 seconds, (4) plug the router back in and wait until its internet light is solid, (5) plug the base station back in. Then check the base station LED — it should turn solid green/blue within a couple of minutes.
